thread:
maria-billing: Quick sync: found a cluster of delayed token ingestion causing invoice undercounts for ~12 customers. Proposing an automated credit pipeline to reduce manual reissues. Need owner and timeline.

alex-finance: Automated credits sound good but we need guardrails. Suggest auto-credit when delta <= $30 AND <=5% of invoice. Anything else goes to manual reissue queue. Who will own audit logs?

sam-platform: I can own the pipeline delivery (build + deploy). Plan: implement auto-credit service that writes an audit event to finance ledgers and requires finance confirmation for reissue. ETA 48h for MVP.

jamie-sre: Containment: throttled ingest workers and disabled the new retry middleware. No new gaps in the last 3h. I'll validate parity post-reingest.

nora-ops: CS impact: automated credits will speed CS responses. I'll draft customer language and escalation playbook. Need exportable audit CSV from the credit service.

maria-billing: Owner summary: @sam-platform = auto-credit service (48h MVP), @alex-finance = policy + final approvals, @nora-ops = CS messaging, @jamie-sre = reingest verification. Weekly follow-up until closed.

alex-finance: One more: require dual-approve (finance + billing lead) for auto-credit > $150. I'll add to the policy doc and approve flow.

sam-platform: Starting implementation now. Will post PR and canary link in this thread.

maria-billing: Thanks all. Keeping updates here.
